message.content: I check the tickets at the entrance, restock the snack shelves, and sweep the lobby. I usually start at eight in the morning, take the tram, and get to work around eight thirty. My sister and I live together, so she makes sure I'm okay. The voice I hear doesn't bother me much when I'm busy, but if I'm tired or not sleeping well, it's more noticeable. I don't know what it means, but it's not loud or threatening. I just try to keep my routine as normal as possible.
